verdicts.reason: A breaks the design apart: the white label frame is pushed off to the right with nothing in it, its rule lines float loose, stray dashes sit at each side, the text order is scrambled (LAVANDER above HOMEMADE LOTION above J'adore Paris above SKINCARE), and the illustrations are shrunk into a tiny strip at the bottom. B keeps the label with its text in the right order and keeps the illustration scene, but the two rule lines float outside the label across the right side, the stray dashes collide with the vase and lavender, and the soap bars sit on top of the bottom edge of the label.
